name: eating
description: Putting food in your mouth, chewing, and swallowing.
results: Most of the time, eating is pleasurable. But it can also be disappointing, stressful, or sickening.
Eating is often combined with a social activity.

guidance.description: These articles suggest ways to categorize different types of eating habits.

variations.name: social grazing
variations.description: Eating small amounts of food over an extended period in a social environment.
perceptions: Eating is a way to engage in a social environment.
It shows others I'm engaged with them.
It's free or I already paid for it.

variations.name: comfort snacking
variations.description: Eating primarily for the rewarding brain chemicals.
perceptions: It would be nice to have a snack and there's no harm in doing so.

comparisons.description: 'Eating' is a particular kind of consumption, a very important action and pleasure for most people.

commentaries.quote: One cannot think well, love well, sleep well, if one has not dined well.
Food brings people together on many different levels.
Those who think they have no time for healthy eating, will sooner or later have to find time for illness.
If more of us valued food and cheer and song above hoarded gold, it would be a merrier world.
A party without cake is just a meeting.
Food is a lot of people's therapy - when we say comfort food, we really mean that. It's releasing dopamine and serotonin in your brain that makes you feel good.
After a full belly all is poetry.
